items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a locally quasi-finite and separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is representable (source lines 10929-10934). The proof applies the proposition that a locally quasi-finite separated morphism over a representable base has representable source, together with the stability of both properties under arbitrary base change, which reduces representability to the case of a representable base.
